source_row.rationale: Syncope is defined as a transient, complete loss of consciousness and postural tone due to temporarily reduced cerebral blood flow, typically with rapid, spontaneous, and complete recovery — distinct from near-syncope (presyncope), which involves the sensation of impending loss of consciousness (lightheadedness, graying vision) without an actual complete loss of consciousness.
source_row.source_detail: Syncope definition: transient loss of consciousness from cerebral hypoperfusion with rapid spontaneous complete recovery; reviewed 2026-08-14.
